Primary request: portray the Withholding Sage, the passive shadow of Sage: Clarity has collapsed while Curiosity expands into endless qualification after enough evidence exists to offer bounded counsel.
Scene/backdrop: a practical counsel workshop with several coherent sets of ordinary material samples, balanced weights, clear lenses, and completed physical comparisons; a simple decision marker remains unplaced beside an open path.
Subject: an older woman continues adding another lens and another tray to an already sufficient comparison, while her free hand hovers above but does not place the plain marker; thoughtful and responsible rather than indecisive caricature.
Mechanism cues: inquiry is rich and competent, yet synthesis and usable counsel never arrive; grouped evidence and the waiting marker show that provisional clarity is available.
Lighting/mood: layered cool daylight with a narrow warm beam on the unplaced marker, contemplative, restrained, psychologically exact.
Asset type: full-bleed print field-guide portrait illustration.
Style/medium: richly detailed painterly realism with a grounded editorial, mythopoetic sensibility; natural anatomy and expressive lined faces; tactile linen, worn wood, stone, iron, glass, clay, and paper; visible brush texture; restrained charcoal, indigo, umber, muted teal, moss, and ember-gold palette; soft directional chiaroscuro; coherent with a serious mature archetype book.
Composition/framing: strict vertical 2:3 portrait; one fully clothed older or mature adult woman; crop-safe face, hands, and essential mechanism in the upper two-thirds; no critical focal content at side edges; lower third may hold secondary environmental detail; strong readable silhouette at print scale.
Constraints: brand-new no-input artwork; no copied or reference imagery; no text, letters, glyphs, diagrams, labels, captions, typography, illustrated books, borders, logos, or watermarks; no crowns, thrones, scepters, halos, goddess/deity iconography, sacred regalia, occult shorthand, fortune-telling props, ritual circles, magic, or supernatural effects; no sexualization, glamour pose, villain caricature, children, visible abuse, racial or cultural stereotypes, or identifiable living-tradition dress.
Avoid: generic fantasy crone, witch, oracle, angel, saint, victim, servant, gagged-silence imagery, smug know-it-all caricature, or stock-photo imagery; distorted hands; extra fingers; important elements near extreme edges.
